title: fix(plugin-form): the default ObjectForm edit of a record that does not exist shows the not-found state, not an empty editable form

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbU6Spbw4xkAoD9ipE5aNk6r)_

Fixes #29354

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Declarations as set by the claim (card comment 6578598549), which fixes the file surface: `ObjectForm.tsx`, `loadFailure.ts` only for a small extension of its helper, their tests and a root changeset.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:默认布局(`simple`)的对象表单在编辑一条不存在的记录时，现在显示「Record not found」未找到状态，不再显示可编辑的空白表单，也没有「更新」按钮。这是五种记录表单里最后一个缺这个状态的；画法复用 PR #29351 在 `loadFailure.ts` 里加的同一个私有组件。新建和编辑已存在的记录不变。
- **为什么改**:用户从已删除记录的旧链接打开默认表单，会看到空白表单，填完点更新才被告知记录不存在。弹窗、抽屉、分页签、向导四种表单已由 PR #29246 和 PR #29351 修好。
- **风险与回滚**:低。记录读取 effect 在 `findOne` 返回 `null` 时记一次 `RecordNotFoundError` 加载失败、不再把 `null` 填进表单；原有「加载失败时不画表单」的提前返回接管其余。表单打开期间后台重读发现记录已删，也显示同一状态(与其余四种表单一致)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` 记录读取 effect 里的 `data == null` 分支，以及 `SimpleObjectForm` 渲染开头 `error instanceof RecordNotFoundError` 的分支。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.recordNotFound-29354.test.tsx`,预期 1 个文件、8 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **A null edit read is a failure, not a record, in the default layout too.** `DataSource.findOne` is typed `T | null`, and the ObjectStack adapter's `readOne` answers `null` when the server answers 404. `SimpleObjectForm` (the default `object-form` arm) passed that answer straight to `snapshotLoadedRecord` and `setInitialData` and committed the read, so an edit form for a deleted or unknown record drew a blank editable form with an enabled Update button. It now fails the record read with the package-private `RecordNotFoundError`, through the per-read failure run every other load failure uses, and neither seeds the form nor takes a save baseline. This is the branch the four other record layouts already take.
- **The same drawing.** When the shown load failure is a `RecordNotFoundError`, the layout returns the shared private `RecordNotFoundState` (test id `simple-form-record-not-found`) ahead of the generic "Error loading form" box. That early return is the one that already kept the form, its footer and its submit off screen for any load failure.
- **Also on a background re-read.** A bus re-read (`useRecordInvalidation`) that finds the record deleted while the form is open shows the same state, as in the drawer, tabbed and wizard layouts. A later re-read that finds the record again commits and takes the screen back, as for any record read failure.
- **Unchanged.** Create (or no id) never reads; inline-field forms never read; an edit of a record that exists draws its form as before. No new string, no new export from the package entry, no prop or schema change.
- `loadFailure.ts`: one JSDoc line now names `ObjectForm`'s default arm among the callers of `RecordNotFoundState` (comment only; the seat confirmed it is inside the claimed surface).

## Why

A user who opens an old link to a deleted record in the default object form saw a blank form, filled it in, and learned the record did not exist only on save.

## Tests

- New `ObjectForm.recordNotFound-29354.test.tsx`, one `describe.each` over the flat and the sectioned render paths of `ObjectForm` (no `formType`, so the default arm, with the real registered fields): a `null` read draws "Record not found", its description and the `simple-form-record-not-found` test id, with no `title` input, no Update button and no "Error loading form"; a found record that a bus re-read then finds deleted switches to the same state; CONTROL a found record still draws its form and Update; CONTROL a create draws an empty form with Create and never calls `findOne`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live console not measured.** The chain is pinned in vitest from the `findOne` answer down; the adapter's 404 to `null` mapping is read from `ObjectStackAdapter.readOne`, not re-exercised, and no Console route that mounts the default layout for an edit was driven.
- **After a not-found re-read the save baseline is left as it was** (`loadedRecordRef`), as in the other layouts: nothing can save while the not-found state is drawn, and the next successful read replaces it.
